task1.title: Top ten countries for the production and consumption of electricity in 2014
task1.prompt: The bar chart below shows the top ten countries for the production and consumption of electricity in 2014.

chartDesc.overview: China and the United States significantly outproduced and consumed far more electricity than any of the other top ten countries. In almost all listed countries, production exceeded consumption, with Germany being the only exception.
keyFeatures: China was the highest producer (5,398 billion kWh) and consumer (5,322 billion kWh) of electricity.
The United States was second in both categories, producing 4,099 billion kWh and consuming 3,866 billion kWh.
Germany was the only nation where consumption (582.5 billion kWh) surpassed production (526.6 billion kWh).
Korea, Rep. had the lowest totals in the top 10, with 485.1 billion kWh produced and 449.5 billion kWh consumed.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: The importance of History as a school subject
task2.prompt:
Some people say History is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that, in today's world, subjects like Science and Technology are more important than History.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
